title: Carry the new fields through the WorkManager fallback's workDataOf
description: The coarse (WorkManager) fallback path must carry the same new extras as the exact-alarm path so CoarseReminderWorker (task-010) can build the same notification action.

Three new lines immediately follow it: EXTRA_PROFILE_ID to profileId, EXTRA_MEDICATION_ID to medicationId, EXTRA_DEFAULT_DOSE_AMOUNT to defaultDoseAmount,
